overview.positioning: Build a Real Store. Test Every Order Flow. Learn to Operate It.
overview.short_description: Learn to create and manage WooCommerce stores on WordPress. Set up product catalogues, variations, shopping carts, payments, taxes, shipping, inventory, order workflows and e-commerce reporting through a practical store-development project. Go beyond attractive product pages. Learn how an online store works from product listing and checkout to payment handling, shipping configuration, inventory updates, refunds and daily administration.
overview.additional_positioning: This practical specialization focuses on the operational side of online commerce. Students develop a working demonstration store, configure its essential settings and test realistic purchase scenarios before completing a professional store handover.
overview.why_it_matters: WooCommerce allows businesses to build and operate online stores using WordPress. A properly configured store requires more than visual design. It also needs reliable checkout workflows, accurate product and stock data, appropriate payment methods, shipping rules, customer communication and order administration.

why_now.industry_shift: Modern e-commerce requires full ownership over customer data, transaction workflows, and order architectures. With High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and block-based checkout, WooCommerce delivers scalable commerce on independent infrastructure.
why_now.ai_impact: AI tools accelerate product catalogue drafting and customer service template creation, but human operational rigor is essential for inventory reconciliation, tax accuracy, and payment security.
why_now.business_demand: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, retailers, and small businesses need professionals who can not only set up product pages, but also configure shipping rules, resolve payment exceptions, and handle daily order logistics.
why_now.career_opportunity: WooCommerce specialists possess tangible operational skills that translate into high-demand roles as store managers, e-commerce assistants, and freelance store developers with recurring operational retainers.

ideal_for: Professionals managing daily online store operations
target_audience.who_should_take: Anyone seeking practical skills to build, configure, test, and administer functioning WooCommerce stores with reliable checkout, payments, shipping, and order management.

cost_transparency.overview: WooCommerce core software is free, but operating a real business store involves legitimate commercial infrastructure costs:

cost_elements.notes: No platform percentage taken by Automattic/WooCommerce.
Requires reliable hosting with SSL and adequate PHP memory.
Gateways (Razorpay, Stripe, Cashfree) charge per-transaction fees (typically 2%).
Advanced shipping, subscriptions, or memberships may require paid annual licenses.
Mandatory for encrypted checkout and customer trust.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Drafting product specifications, writing engaging marketing descriptions, generating SEO meta tags, creating email notification templates, and outlining store policy drafts.
ai_integration.ai_can_automate: Generating CSV seed product variations, structuring boilerplate documentation, and suggesting catalog taxonomy categories.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Validating pricing accuracy, setting correct tax rates and GST classes, configuring payment gateway API keys, checking shipping rate calculations, and testing refund mechanisms.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: All AI-drafted product information, policies, and documentation must be independently reviewed for commercial accuracy, tax compliance, and consumer trust before publishing.

best_practices: Use modern block-based Cart and Checkout for higher conversion rates and cleaner code.
Verify extension compatibility before upgrading WooCommerce or enabling High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
Always test payment gateways in sandbox or staging mode before accepting real customer cards.
Assign unique SKUs to every product variation to prevent inventory tracking errors.
Configure automated off-site backups prior to updating core plugins or database tables.
Exclude Cart, Checkout, and My Account pages from aggressive server and browser caching.
Set clear shipping rates, delivery timelines, and return policies to minimize customer disputes.
Create a dedicated Shop Manager role for store operators rather than sharing master Administrator access.
common_mistakes: Claiming a WooCommerce store is completely free while hiding hosting, domain, and gateway fee realities.
Using outdated checkout shortcodes with conflicting plugins that cause checkout errors.
Testing payments on a live store with real money instead of using sandbox credentials.
Failing to configure low-stock alerts, resulting in customer orders for out-of-stock items.
Caching checkout pages, causing customer cart data to mix up or display empty carts.
Ignoring mobile checkout usability, leading to high cart abandonment on smartphones.
Updating WooCommerce without verifying theme and payment plugin compatibility.
Failing to document refund procedures and store administration for non-technical clients.

lessons.why_it_matters: Some legacy payment or shipping plugins do not support block checkout, risking broken orders.
lessons.expected_outcome: Documented extension compatibility audit report.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build and test the complete customer purchase journey from catalog to thank-you page.
modules.assignment: Document usability issues identified in desktop and mobile checkout testing.
modules.business_application: Designing conversion-optimized e-commerce storefronts for merchants.
modules.expected_outcome: Responsive storefront with functional product, cart and checkout flows.

modules.module_purpose: Configure essential checkout transaction settings and fulfilment rules safely.

lessons.what_is_taught: Payment gateway architecture, available regional gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, Stripe, PayPal), merchant onboarding overview, processing fee realities, sandbox vs. live mode, and secure API key management.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures payment gateway sandbox credentials and verifies test API communication.
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding payment security and fee structures is critical for commercial store operations.
lessons.expected_outcome: Connected payment gateway sandbox ready for test transactions.

lessons.what_is_taught: Executing test transactions, simulating successful payments, simulating declined and failed card payments, handling pending authorizations, monitoring order status transitions, and troubleshooting webhook failures.
lessons.what_learner_does: Runs both successful and deliberately failed payment simulations, logging resulting order statuses.
lessons.why_it_matters: Stores must handle payment failures gracefully to prevent customer frustration and lost revenue.
lessons.expected_outcome: Verified transaction test log documenting success and failure handling.

lessons.what_is_taught: Cash on Delivery (COD) configuration, setting eligibility rules (e.g., minimum cart value, specific shipping methods), order confirmation workflows, and managing operational return/fraud risks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures COD with conditional restrictions and tests COD checkout placement.
lessons.why_it_matters: COD remains a vital payment method in India but requires strict operational rules to manage risk.
lessons.expected_outcome: Configured COD payment workflow with defined eligibility constraints.

lessons.what_is_taught: Configuring shipping zones (Local, State, National), postal-code filters, flat-rate shipping, free shipping conditions (coupons, minimum spend), local pickup, shipping classes (e.g., Heavy, Fragile), and clear delivery policy communication.
lessons.what_learner_does: Sets up Indian regional shipping zones, flat-rate pricing, and free shipping thresholds.
lessons.why_it_matters: Clear shipping calculation prevents cart abandonment and ensures delivery costs are covered.
lessons.expected_outcome: Configured multi-tier shipping zone system with tested delivery rates.

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating percentage discounts, fixed cart discounts, fixed product discounts, setting coupon restrictions (minimum spend, excluded sale items), usage limits (per coupon, per user), and testing promotional rules.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates promotional coupons and tests application across eligible and restricted carts.
lessons.why_it_matters: Promotional campaigns drive sales but require strict limits to safeguard profit margins.
lessons.expected_outcome: Configured discount rules with validated restriction controls.

lessons.what_is_taught: Basic WooCommerce tax settings, standard and custom tax classes, tax-inclusive vs. tax-exclusive pricing display, shipping tax calculations, Indian GST configuration principles, and invoice plugin selection.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures standard tax rates and verifies tax display on product and cart pages.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper operational tax display ensures transparency and compliance with tax laws.
lessons.expected_outcome: Documented tax configuration with verified line-item tax calculations.

lessons.what_is_taught: Configuring WooCommerce transactional emails: New Order (admin), Processing Order (customer), Completed Order, and Cancellation/Refund alerts; SMTP setup, email deliverability testing, and troubleshooting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Customizes email notification branding and tests delivery using a safe mail logger.
lessons.why_it_matters: Automated, reliable transactional emails are vital for customer reassurance and order tracking.
lessons.expected_outcome: Branded, fully tested transactional notification pipeline.

modules.hands_on_practice: Configure a test payment gateway sandbox and set up multi-tier shipping zones.
modules.assignment: Test checkout using different shipping addresses, coupons, payment states and order values.
modules.business_application: Setting up commercial payment processing, shipping logistics, and customer communications.
modules.expected_outcome: Documented payment, tax, shipping and notification configuration.

modules.module_purpose: Operate WooCommerce safely and identify common store reliability issues.

lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating the WooCommerce order dashboard, moving orders through statuses (Pending, Processing, On Hold, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded), adding customer notes, tracking shipments, and handling refunds.
lessons.what_learner_does: Processes an incoming order from 'Processing' to 'Completed', adds private notes, and sends customer updates.
lessons.why_it_matters: Efficient order management ensures accurate fulfillment and prompt customer communication.
lessons.expected_outcome: Demonstrated competency in full order lifecycle administration.

lessons.what_is_taught: Observing automated stock reduction upon order placement, restock behavior upon order cancellation, tracking low-stock notifications, manual stock adjustments, and inventory reconciliation principles.
lessons.what_learner_does: Places an order, verifies stock reduction, cancels the order, and confirms automated stock restoration.
lessons.why_it_matters: Accurate real-time inventory synchronization is the backbone of reliable e-commerce fulfillment.
lessons.expected_outcome: Validated inventory decrement and restoration test evidence.

lessons.what_is_taught: Understanding HPOS architecture (dedicated custom order tables vs. legacy WordPress posts table), database scalability benefits, checking extension and theme compatibility, safe testing before enabling, and rollback awareness.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audits store extensions for HPOS compatibility and reviews order table architecture.
lessons.why_it_matters: HPOS represents the modern standard for WooCommerce, boosting database query speed during peak sales.
lessons.expected_outcome: Documented HPOS compatibility evaluation and architecture report.

lessons.what_is_taught: Safe update routines for WordPress core, WooCommerce, and extensions; staging site workflows, backup scheduling, restoration testing, user privilege controls, and basic store security hardening.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a pre-update store backup, tests updates on staging, and documents maintenance routines.
lessons.why_it_matters: Unplanned live updates can corrupt customer orders or break payment gateway processing.
lessons.expected_outcome: Established store maintenance checklist and automated backup schedule.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using WooCommerce Analytics (Revenue, Orders, Products, Categories, Coupons, Taxes, Downloads, Stock), GA4 e-commerce measurement concepts, privacy/consent compliance, and conversion drop-off diagnostics.
lessons.what_learner_does: Analyzes store sales reports, identifies top-performing products, and reviews inventory valuation.
lessons.why_it_matters: Data-driven analytics empower merchants to identify profitable products and improve marketing ROI.
lessons.expected_outcome: Compiled store performance report with key sales and inventory metrics.

lessons.what_is_taught: Auditing store speed using Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse, image optimization, caching strategies, mandatory caching exclusions (Cart, Checkout, My Account), mobile speed, plugin conflict resolution, and inspecting error logs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures caching exclusion rules and inspects WooCommerce system status error logs.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper caching exclusions ensure customers always see their own updated carts and personal order details.
lessons.expected_outcome: Optimized store configuration with verified caching exclusions and clean error logs.

modules.hands_on_practice: Simulate an order cancellation, a refund scenario, and inventory reconciliation.
modules.assignment: Create a store maintenance and incident-response checklist.

modules.expected_outcome: Order administration documentation, analytics evidence and store reliability checklist.

faq.question: What will I learn in this WooCommerce course?
faq.answer: You will learn to create and manage WooCommerce stores using WordPress, including products, inventory, cart and checkout, payment testing, shipping, taxes, orders, refunds and essential reporting.

faq.question: Do I need WordPress knowledge before joining?
faq.answer: Yes, basic WordPress knowledge is recommended. Beginners can complete Course 62 or demonstrate equivalent skills through a readiness assessment.

faq.question: Is WooCommerce completely free?
faq.answer: The WooCommerce core plugin is free, but hosting, domains, payment processing and optional premium extensions may have additional costs.

faq.question: Will I learn payment gateway integration?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn payment configuration and safe testing using a suitable region-supported sandbox or simulated payment workflow.

faq.question: Will I build an actual working store?
faq.answer: You will build a functional demonstration store with at least 15 products, product variations, cart and checkout workflows, shipping rules, test orders and operational documentation.

faq.question: Does the course include inventory management?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn product stock settings, SKU management, stock updates and basic inventory administration.

faq.question: Will I learn shipping and tax settings for Indian stores?
faq.answer: The course introduces relevant WooCommerce shipping and tax configuration workflows, including Indian shipping zones and GST-related concepts. Business-specific legal compliance requires separate verification.

faq.question: What is HPOS in WooCommerce?
faq.answer: High-Performance Order Storage is WooCommerce's dedicated order-storage architecture. The course introduces its purpose and the importance of compatible themes, plugins and integrations.

faq.question: Can I start offering WooCommerce freelance services?
faq.answer: The course develops practical skills applicable to beginner-level WooCommerce store setup and administration. Freelance income and client acquisition are not guaranteed.

faq.question: How long is the course and what is the fee?
faq.answer: The course lasts eight weeks, includes 64 guided training hours and has a listed fee of ₹9,900, subject to the website's verified pricing and tax policy.

faq.question: Why does the course prioritize block checkout over shortcodes?
faq.answer: Modern WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks provide faster page loads, fewer form fields, and a seamless one-page mobile checkout experience. We teach block checkout as the modern default, while also auditing extension compatibility.

faq.question: How are payment test scenarios conducted without real credit cards?
faq.answer: All payment testing is conducted strictly in sandbox mode using authorized test credentials (such as Razorpay or Stripe test cards) or safe simulated checkout methods. Students never use real money or expose live card details.

faq.question: What test scenarios must I prove for my portfolio project?
faq.answer: You must demonstrate 7 operational scenarios: successful order placement, declined payment handling, automatic inventory reduction, order cancellation with restock, refund processing, transactional email trigger, and conditional shipping/coupon calculations.

faq.question: What is included in the Client Store Handover deliverable?
faq.answer: The client handover package includes a non-technical Store Administration Guide, product upload instructions, order fulfillment steps, refund workflow procedures, and a recorded walkthrough demonstration.

faq.question: Will I receive a verifiable certificate upon completion?
faq.answer: Yes. Students who complete all six curriculum modules, deliver the 15+ product demonstration store, verify all 7 test scenarios, and pass the evaluation with at least 70% earn the verified Nova Skills Certificate of Completion in WooCommerce Store Development & Operations.
